rutinas.text:
Mariana is a nurse in Córdoba. Her shifts start early, so she has a simple routine.

First, she gets up at six o'clock in the morning. Then she has breakfast with coffee and toast. After that, she takes a shower and gets dressed for work.

At half past seven, she goes to work at the hospital. She works with Dr. Pérez and many patients.

In the afternoon, she has lunch with her friend Lucas in the hospital cafeteria. They talk about their day.

After work, she goes home and cooks dinner. At night, she watches TV for a little while.

Finally, she goes to bed at ten o'clock. Tomorrow, she starts again.

questions.prompt: Según el texto, ¿cómo se dice correctamente "por la noche mira televisión"?

On the night she watches TV.
At the night she watches TV.
questions.explanation: Para referirse a la noche se usa "at night", no "in the night"; en cambio se dice "in the morning" e "in the afternoon".

rutinas.text:
Sofía works as an English teacher in Rosario. On her first day, her new colleague, Diego, asks about her daily routine.

Sofía says, 'First, I get up at quarter to seven. Then I have a shower and get dressed.'

'What about breakfast?' asks Diego.

'After that, I have breakfast with my husband. We have tea and bread,' says Sofía.

'And when do you go to work?' Diego asks.

'At half past eight, I go to work by bus,' she answers. 'In the morning, I teach three classes. In the afternoon, I correct homework and plan lessons.'

'What do you do at night?' Diego asks.

'At night, I read a book or call my sister. Finally, I go to bed at eleven o'clock,' says Sofía.

Diego smiles and says, 'That sounds like a nice routine!'

questions.explanation: El texto indica "In the afternoon, I correct homework and plan lessons", es decir que corrige tareas y planifica clases.
